title: Systems of Linear ODEs & Phase Plane Topology

sections.heading: Systems of Linear ODEs & Phase Plane Topology Practice Exercises

questions.q: The matrix of \( \mathbf x'=A\mathbf x \) has eigenvalues \( \pm i \). The origin is a:
questions.answer: Complex eigenvalues give spirals; the sign of the real part decides stability, and a zero real part gives a center. Here: center (stable, not asymptotically).

questions.q: Solve \( x'=2 x,\ y'=- y \) with \( x(0)=-1,\ y(0)=3 \). Find \( x(\ln{\left(2 \right)}) \).
questions.answer: The equations are decoupled: \( x=- e^{2 t} \), \( y=3 e^{- t} \). Hence \( -4 \).

questions.q: With \( x_1=y \), \( x_2=y' \), the equation \( y''+3y=0 \) becomes \( \mathbf x'=A\mathbf x \). Find \( A \).
questions.answer: \( x_1'=x_2 \) and \( x_2'=y''=- 3 x_{1} \), so \( A=\left[\begin{matrix}0 & 1\\-3 & 0\end{matrix}\right] \).

questions.q: The matrix of \( \mathbf x'=A\mathbf x \) has eigenvalues \( \pm 5i \). The origin is a:
questions.answer: Complex eigenvalues give spirals; the sign of the real part decides stability, and a zero real part gives a center. Here: center (stable, not asymptotically).

questions.q: Solve \( x'=- x,\ y'=- y \) with \( x(0)=-2,\ y(0)=4 \). Find \( y(\ln{\left(2 \right)}) \).
questions.answer: The equations are decoupled: \( x=- 2 e^{- t} \), \( y=4 e^{- t} \). Hence \( 2 \).

questions.q: With \( x_1=y \), \( x_2=y' \), the equation \( y''+y'+y=0 \) becomes \( \mathbf x'=A\mathbf x \). Find \( A \).
questions.answer: \( x_1'=x_2 \) and \( x_2'=y''=- x_{1} - x_{2} \), so \( A=\left[\begin{matrix}0 & 1\\-1 & -1\end{matrix}\right] \).

questions.q: The matrix of \( \mathbf x'=A\mathbf x \) has eigenvalues \( -2\pm 4i \). The origin is a:
questions.answer: Complex eigenvalues give spirals; the sign of the real part decides stability, and a zero real part gives a center. Here: stable spiral.
The equations are decoupled: \( x=4 e^{- t} \), \( y=- e^{t} \). Hence \( \frac{4}{e} \).
